reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Gain momentum in reducing TB/ HIV burden through forging universal access for timely and quality TB diagnosis and treatment, scaling up evidence-based HIV prevention, diagnosis and treatment, building up resilient and sustainable systems for health - Ukraine (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Ukraine, TB/HIV, Charitable Organization "All-Ukrainian Network of People Living with HIV/AIDS" (CO "100 PERCENT LIFE")This program has the following goals: To gain momentum in further reducing TB and HIV burden through forging universal access for timely and quality TB and DR-TB diagnosis and treatment, scaling up evidence-based HIV prevention, diagnosis and treatment and building up resilient and sustainable systems for health. The objectives of this program are: To forge universal access for timely and quality people centered TB and DR-TB diagnosis, treatment and care. To scale up evidence-based HIV prevention, diagnosis and treatment responses focused primarily on KP towards attainment 90:90:90 and prevention targets. To build up resilient and sustainable system for health
